Other Ingredients: BSE-free gelatin (capsule), vegetable glycerine, double-distilled and deionized water.

Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, take one or two capsules with a meal or as directed by your healthcare provider. If needed, may be taken with liquids to aid in swallowing.

Warning: Do not use if you are pregnant or nursing, have vascular disease, are taking other medications, are preparing for surgery without first consulting your healthcare professional.

Storage Instructions: Keep out of reach of children. Safety sealed for your protection. Do not use if safety seal is broken. Keep bottle tightly closed. Store in cool, dry place away from sunlight.

Other Information: Devoid of any fillers, additives, colors, preservatives, soy or gluten., Tocopherol-Free
